invariants.rationale: The method uses preppedRecords directly, so it cannot be null.
instantTime is passed to several methods as a parameter, so a non-null value is reasonable.
The method always returns the result of postWrite, which is expected to be non-null.
result is declared as List<WriteStatus>; invariant confirms type.
If there is something to write, typically output should not be empty; if input is empty, output could be empty.
